page.overview:
Who is Ultros?

Ultros is a minor antagonist in Chocobo's Dungeon 2.

Ultros is the boss of the Sea Floor Dungeon, the third dungeon. He is fought on 27F with Shiroma as an ally. He is accompanied by 2 Ultros' Hands.

When out of melee range, Ultros will cast Drain repeatedly, damaging the Chocobo and healing himself for approximately 40 HP. Due to the small size of the arena, he can reach Chocobo with Drain anytime.

Blitz Claws are a good way to exploit Ultros' weakness to lightning.
